item.text: I’ll read the selected lyric, reconstruct the Urdu verses, and check them line by line against the Roman transcription.

---
title: "Daldo Koi Zakhmon Pe Chadar"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Noha"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

Daal do koi zakhmon pe chadar

Haay! Akbar ki maa aa rahi hai

Seena Akbar ka rakho chhupakar

Haay! Akbar ki maa aa rahi hai

Biwiyon milke halqa banaa lo

Maa jawa'n laal ki hai sambhalo

Marr na jaye woh laashe pe aakr

Haay! Akbar ki maa aa rahi hai

Dekh legi agar Umm-e-layla

Apne bacche ka zakhmi kaleja

Saans bhi lena payegi maader

Haay! Akbar ki maa aa rahi hai

Mannatein mankr jisko pala

Uske seene me zalim ka bhala

Kaise dekhegi mader yeh manzar

Haay! Akbar ki maa aa rahi hai

Jisko dulha banane ke din the

Jiski shaadi rachane ke din the

Usko dekhegi maa khoon me tarr

Koi arman dil ka na nikla

Loot gayi Umm-e-layla ki duniya

Bayen karne ko laash-e-jawa'n par

Haay! Akbar ki maa aa rahi hai..

Rakh ke khaime me Akbar ka laasha

Sar jhukha kr bahut roye maula

Jab kahaa biwi Fizzan rokar

Haay! Akbar ki maa aa rahi hai

Bayen vahis yeh khaime me goonja

Dekh le apne Yusuf ka laasha

Khaaq uDati hui piT-ti sar

Haaye! Akbar ki maa aa rahi hai

ہائے! اکبر کی ماں آ رہی ہے

۱
بیویو مل کے حلقہ بنا لو
ماں جواں لال کی ہے سنبھالو

ہائے! اکبر کی ماں آ رہی ہے

۲
دیکھ لے گی اگر اُمِّ لیلیٰ

ہائے! اکبر کی ماں آ رہی ہے

کیسے دیکھے گی مادر یہ منظر
ہائے! اکبر کی ماں آ رہی ہے

ہائے! اکبر کی ماں آ رہی ہے

blocks = []
offset = 0

    block = lines[offset:offset + size]
    if index:
        block = [str(index), *block]
    blocks.append(block)
    offset += size
assert [len(block.splitlines()) for block in body.strip().split(\"\\n\\n\")] == [len(block) for block in blocks]
roman_yaml = \"\\n\\n\".join(\"\\n\".join(\"  \" + line for line in block) for block in blocks)

item.text:
Reconstructed all 31 verses in Urdu script and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Both editions have the same opening and seven numbered stanzas. Updated the title and right-to-left direction and cleared the `noUrdu` tag.

Two readings are uncertain. I rendered “Fizzan” as `فضّاں` and read “Bayen vahis” as `بینِ وحشت`.
